why: Each locale's bundle, as `crates/sdk/build.rs` compiles it from `i18n/` into every artefact, in bytes. `crates/intl/tests/pack_budgets.rs` holds each both ways: a bundle over its budget fails, and so does a budget more than a quarter over its bundle, a locale with no budget and a budget with no locale. A budget moves by hand, in the change that needs it, with the reason in the commit. Set 2026-10-23 about a tenth over the bundles measured then: en-Latn 107,795, hi-Deva-IN 70,714, ne-Deva-NP 143,491, sa-Deva 50,528, sa-Latn 39,702. Raised 2026-10-31 for hi-Deva-IN and sa-Deva, which gained the whole of `sdk.calendar` (SR-75). Raised 2026-11-02 for en-Latn and ne-Deva-NP, about a tenth over 121,709 and 163,005, after the lexicon, the chart disagreements, the paya, the doshas and the Jain calendar named their keys (SR-41, SR-32, SR-48, SR-59). Raised 2026-11-03 for hi-Deva-IN, about a tenth over 89,696, after the mundane kinds named their keys (SR-45). Raised 2026-11-10 for hi-Deva-IN, sa-Deva and sa-Latn, about a tenth over 127,163, 96,364 and 75,565, after the three gained the composed text as drafts, `sa-Latn` by derivation (SR-38). Set again 2026-11-10 for every locale, about a tenth over the bundles measured once batch s folded every member's name (SR-12), the Nepali charts' names (SR-36), Kerala's holidays (SR-03), the printed abbreviations (SR-85) and the month-and-year patterns (SR-86): en-Latn 168,596, hi-Deva-IN 183,950, ne-Deva-NP 228,697, sa-Deva 140,118, sa-Latn 108,920. Raised 2026-11-10 for sa-Deva and sa-Latn, about a tenth over 207,036 and 156,432, after every festival was named in Sanskrit. Set again 2026-11-14 for every locale, about a tenth over the bundles measured once Uttar Pradesh's and Odisha's holidays (SR-03) and 28 civil days of the consumer's list (SR-01) were named: en-Latn 183,669, hi-Deva-IN 206,678, ne-Deva-NP 251,562, sa-Deva 229,930, sa-Latn 172,022.
